idf_component_register(
    SRCS "main.c"
         "cc_ble.c"
         "cc_fonts.c"
         "cc_link.c"
         "cc_settings.c"
         "cc_sound.c"
         "cc_store.c"
         "cc_text.c"
         "cc_tone.c"
         "cc_ui.c"
         "cc_view.c"
         "ccp.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES bsp bt esp_timer nvs_flash
)

# Fonts generated by tools/gen_cc_fonts.sh (see assets/README.md).
target_sources(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/cc_font_cjk_16.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/cc_font_ui_12.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/cc_font_ui_20.c"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../assets/fonts/cc_font_num_40.c"
)
